title: Order XXXIX Rule 1 CPC — Temporary injunction

content.overview: Order XXXIX Rule 1 is the temporary-injunction rule for property in dispute, fraudulent disposal and threatened dispossession.
content.study: Prima facie case, balance of convenience and irreparable injury still control. Section 94 is the parent. Rule 3 notice discipline applies to ex parte orders.
